evidence.title: Beyond LoRA: Can you beat the most popular fine-tuning technique?

summary: A new study questions the supremacy of LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) in fine-tuning large language models, proposing alternative methods that may outperform it. The findings could reshape how developers optimize AI models for efficiency and accuracy.
title: Researchers Challenge LoRA as the Dominant AI Fine-Tuning Technique
